origin.description: Install functions into the evaluation environment when that name is not already there.

arguments.text: Named functions. A name that already exists in the environment is left alone.

origin.details: The installed functions are removed when evaluate returns. Calling inject_funs with the previous value restores them.
origin.value: The previous values of those names.
origin.example:
old <- inject_funs(f = function() 1)
ev <- evaluate("f()")
cat(ev[[2]])
inject_funs(old)

translation.description: Install functions into the evaluation environment when that name is not already there.

arguments.text: Named functions. A name that already exists in the environment is left alone.

translation.details: The installed functions are removed when evaluate returns. Calling inject_funs with the previous value restores them.
translation.value: The previous values of those names.
translation.example:
old = inject_funs(f=lambda: 1)
ev = evaluate("f()", envir={})
print(ev[1], end="")
inject_funs(old)
